name: Scenario Agent Skills
cost: Skills are free (MIT). Scenario usage is billed to your Scenario account; prices are not stated in the README
works_with: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot and 70+ other agents
short: AI skills that teach your coding agent to make images, video, audio, textures and 3D assets through the Scenario MCP server.
what: A large set of AI skills for Scenario, a content generation platform. They cover images, video, audio, textures, skyboxes, 3D assets and custom trained models, plus skills for holding one character or style steady across a set and for dry-run pricing before a run. A separate group of expert skills drives desktop tools like Blender, Maya, Unity, Godot and Unreal Engine.
who: Game developers, artists and marketers who want an agent to produce assets in a consistent style. You need a Scenario account, so skip it if you don't plan to use Scenario.
needs: A coding agent that supports AI skills
A Scenario account (OAuth sign-in) or a Scenario API key

steps.title: Pick the skills you want
steps.text: This opens a menu grouped by topic. Nothing is selected at first, so choose before you press enter. INSTALL.md also has one command per role.

steps.title: Connect the Scenario MCP server
steps.text: Or add `https://mcp.scenario.com/mcp` to any MCP client and sign in with your Scenario account.
steps.code: claude mcp add --transport http scenario https://mcp.scenario.com/mcp

try.label: From the README
try.text: Generate four style-matched potion icons with transparent backgrounds for my RPG inventory.

watch: The default commands install the latest copy from `main`. To install a reviewed state, pin a release commit with `npx skills@1.7.4 add scenario-labs/skills#<commit> --skill <name>`.
Generations run on your Scenario account. The skills include dry-run pricing and team spend caps, but the README gives no prices.
The expert tool skills drive apps installed on your machine, like Blender or Unity, and need those apps rather than the MCP server.
